verdict.rationale: The My DOR portal is an online filing and payment system, so recurring scheduled filings or payments are a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows only one-off actions: a single ACH debit per return, saving a draft to file later, and amending a return. Nothing documents a recurring schedule or automated workflow, and probes found no API or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
